header-authorization:
a=$HOME/.codex/auth.json
g() { sed -n "s/.*\"$1\" *: *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p"; }
[ -r "$a" ] || { echo "codex: no $a - run 'codex login' first" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ -n "$(find "$a" -mmin +40)" ]; then
  p=$(g access_token <"$a" | cut -d. -f2 | tr -- '-_' '+/')
  while [ $((${#p} % 4)) -ne 0 ]; do p="$p="; done
  c=$(printf %s "$p" | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null | g client_id)
  r=$(curl -s --max-time 10 https://auth.openai.com/oauth/token -H content-type:application/json -d "{\"client_id\":\"$c\",\"grant_type\":\"refresh_token\",\"refresh_token\":\"$(g refresh_token <"$a")\"}")
  t=$(printf %s "$r" | g access_token)
  if [ -n "$t" ]; then
    (umask 077; sed -e "s|\"access_token\": \"[^\"]*\"|\"access_token\": \"$t\"|" -e "s|\"id_token\": \"[^\"]*\"|\"id_token\": \"$(printf %s "$r" | g id_token)\"|" -e "s|\"refresh_token\": \"[^\"]*\"|\"refresh_token\": \"$(printf %s "$r" | g refresh_token)\"|" "$a" >"$a.m8") && mv "$a.m8" "$a"
  else
    echo "codex: could not refresh the token - run 'codex login' again" >&2
  fi
fi
t=$(g access_token <"$a")
[ -n "$t" ] || { echo "codex: no access token in $a - run 'codex login'" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Bearer $t"
